gloss: high and low; rise and fall; elevation difference

definitions.gloss: high and low; elevation difference; unevenness
definitions.explanation: The difference in height or level between two or more things. Used for terrain, sound pitch, numbers, and other measurable quantities.

examples.japanese: {高低|こうてい}⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高低|こうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}き{分|わ}ける→聞き分ける：29600_kikiwakeru⟧。
examples.english: To distinguish between high and low sounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高低|こうてい}⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{向|む}かない→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: This course has a large elevation change, so it's not suitable for beginners.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) + ⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧ (low). A common pattern in Japanese where two opposite kanji form a compound meaning the range or variation between the two extremes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高低|こうてい}⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: elevation difference, height differential
- ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高低|こうてい}: pitch (of sound)
- ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高低|こうてい}: temperature highs and lows
- {高低|こうてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧: terrain with elevation changes

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{上下|じょうげ}→上下：04282_jouge⟧: up and down — refers to vertical direction or position
- ⟦{強弱|きょうじゃく}→強弱：05559_kyoujaku⟧: strong and weak — variation in strength or intensity
- ⟦{大小|だいしょう}→大小：05557_daishou⟧: large and small — variation in size
- ⟦{長短|ちょうたん}→長短：05558_choutan⟧: long and short — variation in length

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
{高低|こうてい} shares its reading with several other words including ⟦{工程|こうてい}→工程：12415_koutei⟧ (process), ⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧ (schoolyard), and ⟦{皇帝|こうてい}→皇帝：15856_koutei⟧ (emperor). Context makes the meaning clear.
